items.title: Tom Scott interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 1, 2022 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Vince Guaraldi. I remember them all well.

ctx.x: Vince Guaraldi. I remember them all well.

But when you got to the point where you had a reputation and you were doing solo recordings, I’m wondering how much thought did you give to fitting into what niche? Was it going to be jazz-rock, was it — or maybe this didn’t even occur to you. Maybe you were just composing music and looking for tunes that you liked?
